title: Factors Related to the Debt Burden and Outstanding Debts of Members of Soi Dao Settlement Cooperative Limited Chanthaburi Province / ปัจจัยที่มีความสัมพันธ์ต่อภาระหนี้สินและการค้างชำระหนี้ของสมาชิกสหกรณ์นิคมสอยดาว จำกัด จังหวัดจันทบุรี
author: Anupan Promkeawngam; อนุพันธ์ พรมแก้วงาม; Songserm Homglin; ส่งเสริม หอมกลิ่น; Sukhothai Thammathirat Open University; songserm.hom@stou.ac.th
category: เศรษฐกิจและการจัดการ
abstract: This research was survey research with the objectives to study 1) factors related to the outstanding debt payment of members of Soi Dao estate cooperative limited,2) liabilities and outstanding debts repayment of cooperative members,3) relationship among factors related to the outstanding debts repayment with the debts and outstanding debt repayment of cooperative members and 4) suggestions in the debt repayment of members of the cooperative. The population of this study was 1,396 members of Soi Dao estate cooperative limited, Chanthaburi province who owed the outstanding debts on 30 April, 2022. The sample size of 311 people was determined by using Taro Yamane formula with the error value of 0.05 through simple random sampling method. Tool used in this study was questionnaires. Statistics applied in data analysis were such as frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation, Chi-square, and content analysis. The results of the study found that 1) personal factors of cooperative members were mostly female with the age between 60-69 years old, married, completed primary school education, and had the main profession as fruit garden farming, did not have professions outside of the agricultural sector, had the agricultural area less than 10 Rai, and had the membership period of 6-10 years. For the economic and social factors, they mostly earned the income and had expense per year in the range of 100,000-199,999 Baht, had the debts with the village and community funds, had 2 members in the family, had 2 people in the family under their care, and the influence of members in the group and the group leader affected the decision in the debt repayment at the low level. 2) Regarding the debts and outstanding debt repayment, most of the members had the short term outstanding debt repayment with the amount of outstanding debt of more than 500,000 Baht by using the guarantor. Most of the outstanding repayments were in the form of outstanding principle, interest, and fine with the duration of outstanding repayment of 1-2 years. 3) The relationship of related factors
